directive.quote: Build a new Workshop tool start-a-place: makes and starts one Trillion place on this computer.

job: Make a Trillion place on this computer and start it: its key, its config and the running place

distinct_from.why: This tool itself: its README, rows and tests name the engine commands it runs.

The engine's command line: it parses `trillion-local serve PLACE_CONFIG` and runs one place from a config that already exists. It makes no key and writes no config; this tool makes both and then calls it.
The engine's place entry: it reads and checks a place config and serves it. It is what this tool's config is written for, and it creates nothing (no key, no folder, no config).
Adds a place to an account (`place id`, `send-root`, `freeze`, `join`) at a place whose config and key already exist; this tool calls its `place id` once and makes the config and key it reads.
A sign-up at a running place; it reads the config's place key file, it does not make a place.
Makes an account at a place (`account create PLACE_CONFIG`), not the place.
Reads a place key file (base64 on one line) into the vault root; it never makes one.
The place key's size and file limit, read by root.rs; this tool's settings name the same size.
Recovery of an account's lease under a process; it names `trillion-local serve` only as the process that holds the lease.
Which process owns a record store; it names `trillion-local serve` only as one such process.
The engine's own test place: a config and key written inside a Rust test for one process. Its values are this tool's defaults; it is not a tool a person runs.
Status notes of the placement work that describe `trillion-local serve` and `place id`; words, not a way to make a place.
A status note that says a place runs with no hosting app; words, not a way to make one.

phrasings: Make a Trillion place on this computer and start it: its key, its config and the running place
start trillion-local serve with a place config
write a place config and a place key file
start a place and print its place id with trillion-local place id
